signOutEverywhere.title: Sign this person out everywhere
signOutEverywhere.confirm: Sign {{name}} out of every phone and browser?
signOutEverywhere.hint: They stay registered and can sign in again straight away. Use this if an account may be in the wrong hands or a lost phone is still signed in.
signOutEverywhere.done: {{name}} has been signed out everywhere. They will be asked to sign in again the next time they open the app.
signOutEverywhere.failed: We could not sign this person out just now, so nothing changed. Check your connection and try again.
